clusters.name: forkSession-parent-link-writer-cluster
clusters.executionModeRationale: All stories operate on a single tightly-scoped file set (forkSession.ts plus three immediate downstream files: its test file, daemon/run.ts wiring, and CLAUDE.md docs). Parallelizing would create merge conflicts in forkSession.ts and offers no wall-clock advantage on ~80 LoC of work. Serial execution is the right mode.
